connector.name: Marketplaces MCP (RU) - Wildberries & Ozon
connector.registryDescription: Wildberries & Ozon Seller APIs in your AI assistant - schema-driven, safety-gated.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package marketplaces-mcp-ru. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ilyautov account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: WB_API_TOKEN
env.description: Wildberries Seller API token (seller.wildberries.ru → Settings → API access). Leave unset if you do not sell on WB.

env.name: OZON_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Ozon Seller Client ID (seller.ozon.ru → Settings → API keys).

env.name: OZON_API_KEY
env.description: Ozon Seller API key paired with the Client ID.

env.name: OZON_PERF_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Ozon Performance (ads) API Client ID. Optional.

env.name: OZON_PERF_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Ozon Performance API Client Secret. Optional.
